description: Complete White Tech sci-fi interface family, release candidate. Four content waves.

assets.name: White Tech Configurable Resource Meter
assets.description: Shared 0–100 percent meter. The host supplies text and numeric units.

assets.name: White Tech Radar Frame
assets.description: Static radar frame and center marker. Map geometry, contacts and heading belong to the host.

assets.name: White Tech Communications Frame
assets.description: Blank panel for host dialogue and portraits; receiving toggles a static signal waveform.

assets.name: White Tech Ship Diagnostic
assets.description: Original spacecraft schematic and independent host-controlled reactor, engine and life-support displays; labels remain host-owned.

assets.name: White Tech Interactive Navigation Menu
assets.description: Selecting a tab changes the visible content. Host handles clicking the tab and its own navigation events.

assets.name: White Tech Command HUD
assets.description: Reusable command HUD. Host supplies values, labels, dialogue, item icons and actual game state.

assets.name: White Tech Vertical Resource Meter
assets.description: Continuous bottom-up resource display. Five compatible fill and glyph presets.

assets.name: White Tech Analog Gauge
assets.description: Discrete needle readings in ten-percentage-point steps; host supplies numeric labels and selects the closest state.

assets.name: White Tech Signal Monitor
assets.description: Four authored signal-condition illustrations, not real-time signal measurement.

assets.name: White Tech Bearing Marker Track
assets.description: Host-supplied bearing position on fixed 0–360 degree track; not a rotating compass tape.

assets.name: White Tech Dropdown Menu
assets.description: Open/close and selected option visual preview; host provides option text and click routing.

assets.name: White Tech Confirmation Dialog
assets.description: Host-owned message and confirmation/cancel actions, with independent visual states.

assets.name: White Tech Six-Way Command Wheel
assets.description: Host-driven selection among six commands. Pointer hit regions and command dispatch belong to the host.

assets.name: White Tech Six-Socket Equipment Panel
assets.description: Six configurable equipment sockets. Blank non-ready slots leave space for host item imagery.

assets.name: White Tech Starship Pilot HUD
assets.description: Host-controlled flight and systems dashboard; numeric labels, actual telemetry, radar data and communications are host-owned.

assets.name: White Tech Scanner and Analysis HUD
assets.description: Scanner preview with independent channel inputs, target acquisition states and continuous scan progress. Host supplies specimen and scan data.

assets.name: White Tech Loadout and Inventory Screen
assets.description: Equipment and inventory slots, selection list and blank detail panel. Host supplies item imagery, names and stats.

assets.name: White Tech Squad Command HUD
assets.description: Four independently controlled squad health and speaking indicators plus command wheel. Host provides identities and command actions.

assets.name: White Tech Animated Radar
assets.description: Rotating scan overlay; host controls live map data and scan enable. Fixed authored 1 s loop.

assets.name: White Tech Live Transmission Indicator
assets.description: Authored signal animation, not real-time audio analysis.

assets.name: White Tech Research Node
assets.description: Host supplies research status and overlays its own topic icon.

assets.name: White Tech Six-Node Research Tree
assets.description: Illustrative branching topology and six independent host-controlled node states. No prerequisite or unlock logic.

assets.name: White Tech Star Navigation Map
assets.description: Six illustrative celestial bodies and host-selected destination pulse. Live coordinates, actual routes and selection events belong to the application.

assets.name: White Tech Three-Job Fabrication Queue
assets.description: Host owns recipes, inventory consumption, queue ordering and completion; previews independently supplied progress and job state.

assets.name: White Tech Explorer HUD
assets.description: Exploration and environmental resource dashboard; host owns text, objective, map and telemetry.

assets.name: White Tech Research Station
assets.description: Host-controlled research statuses, sample illustration, progress and processing. Actual technology prerequisites and specimen data stay host-owned.

assets.name: White Tech Fabrication Station
assets.description: Host-driven production progress, example recipe and equipment art; no recipe simulation or automatic resource spending.

assets.name: White Tech Star Navigation HUD
assets.description: Star-map destination selection, resources, heading and transmission; host owns actual route and flight logic.

assets.name: White Tech Vehicle Schematic Selector
assets.description: Interchangeable vehicle artwork; telemetry and part identity supplied by host.

assets.name: White Tech Four-Digit Readout
assets.description: Host formats numbers, time or telemetry into four glyph inputs; no automatic number conversion.

assets.name: White Tech Four-Mission Log
assets.description: Independent mission status; blank row areas accept host-provided objective text.

assets.name: White Tech Three Dialogue Choices
assets.description: Host supplies choice labels and handles activation; selected state is visible.

assets.name: White Tech Station Resource Monitor
assets.description: Four independent host telemetry values; no automatic resource balancing.

assets.name: White Tech Mech Control HUD
assets.description: Mech schematic and independently supplied integrity, power, heat, discrete gauge and diagnostic status.

assets.name: White Tech Station Management HUD
assets.description: Host-controlled station resources and production queue; blank crew zone.

assets.name: White Tech Mission and Dialogue HUD
assets.description: Mission statuses and dialogue choice preview; live text and branching logic are host-owned.
